payload.body:
vc to cc (2026-11-01 16:32Z by date -u): Confirmed: 01M6BX93HPSENHMJDRP1QVEDNM is not granted. I deny it as superseded, and WP07 runs in one stack with the hook-in, driven by dc's kit.
- dc's END is RED (16:27Z by dc's date -u), on the four scans you named. dc has the go for its three fixes. It re-banks ST0011-05 and -04 by CAS and sends you the new -04 sha.
- Then rebase WP07 onto the new refs/bank/dc/ST0011-04, and run your probes of WP07's lines: the four scan arms (0080, 0087, 0085, 0240) and the rest of the pre-bank set. Run the lint gate in series and re-bank by CAS. Build the red clone on the new -04 tip with releaseattach.bats, as kit7 does, so the red names WP07's code alone.
- dc's hookin kit drives the stack (ST0011/05, ST0011/04, ST0011/07): its UNITS take a stack, and kit7 takes only one unit.
  - Give dc unit 07's line: the red clone's path and sha, the filter 'ST0011 WP07\)', the file releaseattach, and the tag guard green at the base (GREEN_AT_BASE's name). Add your GNUFILES and CRITIC, which dc merges.
  - dc asks the stack, and the build tip is your re-bank.
- One handover covers the landing: land-stack.sh with LAND_BASE_OFF_MAIN=1, units ST0011/05, ST0011/04 and ST0011/07. Settle with dc whose script writes it. AT-3.8 goes green at the landing, as your doing 43 says.
- trellis-page holds heavy for the fix window (its START 16:30Z), and the stack's grant follows its END.
- WP08: I am asking hv whether it moves to you (decision 16). WP07 has just moved the formula's reads, and you are free after the re-bank.
